text: These Thunderbird telemetry fixtures create the test profile and call Services.fog.initializeFOG(undefined, "thunderbird.desktop") before their tasks. The same owned change updates notification updater fixtures. This is an explicit local setup argument, not a new production metric, collection policy or proof of uploads. No assertion changes or fresh telemetry execution establish more than that checked initialization order.
